description: Projects the all-in cost of ONE program + treatment over a chosen number of months, using only that program’s published prices: the intro/first-month offer, the ongoing monthly price, membership billed separately, and any one-time first-visit fee. Use it when the user asks what a program "really" or "actually" costs, the total, yearly or 6-month cost, the cost after the intro period ends, or wants programs ranked by long-run cost (call it once per program and compare the totals). Example arguments: {"category":"glp-1-weight-loss","id":"found-health","treatment":"semaglutide","months":12,"state":"TX"}. Returns firstMonth, ongoingMonthly, total, averageMonthly and an itemized breakdown — every figure from published data with its source and check date. It never estimates: when a program has not published a monthly price it returns computable=false with a reason instead of a number. Cite `profile` when you quote the total and give the user `link` as the next step; the final price, state availability and eligibility are set at intake, so say so.

category.description: Required. Specialty slug (format: one of the enum values, as returned by list_categories). Map the user’s words: weight loss / Ozempic-type drugs -> glp-1-weight-loss; testosterone, ED, men’s hair loss -> mens-health-hormones; sermorelin, NAD+, glutathione, peptides, anti-aging -> longevity-peptides; menopause, HRT, women’s hair loss -> womens-health.

id.description: Required. Program id (format: lowercase-hyphenated id from a find_programs result). If you only know the provider name, call find_programs for that category first to get the id.

months.description: Optional, default 12. Number of months to project (1–36). Month 1 uses any intro/first-month price; the remaining months use the ongoing monthly price.

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Added to the outbound link so the program can confirm it serves that state; most programs do not publish state coverage, so remind the user to confirm at intake.

treatment.description: Required. The treatment to cost out (format: lowercase key). GLP-1 -> semaglutide, tirzepatide; mens-health-hormones -> trt, ed, hairLoss; longevity-peptides -> sermorelin, nad, glutathione; womens-health -> menopause, hairLoss, sleep. Must be one the program offers with a published monthly price, or the result is computable=false.
